controls.name: C_host_reproduces_M1_3b
controls.must_fire_because: the host side of this run must reproduce M1.3b's published 31 raw / 1 canon / 1 alpha over 31 probe positions AND its committed probe canon digest, before any device number is compared against it
controls.can_fail_because: the host run gives a different number of probe positions, of distinct digests, or a different canon digest than M1.3b committed
controls.null_must_contain: a changed corpus, binary or probe would move the counts or the digest

controls.name: C_raw_drifts_on_device
controls.must_fire_because: raw digests MUST differ across positions on the device, or the run is not exercising process reuse at all and a constant canon is a clean null from a probe that never reached its target (A29)
controls.can_fail_because: device raw distinct count is 1, i.e. no drift to canonicalise away
controls.null_must_contain: a device where the process-global variable counter did not advance would give raw == 1

controls.name: C_device_identified
controls.must_fire_because: the numbers must be attributable to a named aarch64 device with a live battery service -- family B: a frozen override reports whatever it was told to
controls.can_fail_because: model or abi is empty, abi is not arm64, or the battery dump is a frozen override
controls.null_must_contain: an emulator, an empty getprop, or a battery service pinned by a test override

controls.name: C_binary_provenance
controls.must_fire_because: A24: a digest pins WHICH artifact. Both binaries are hashed and the device binary must post-date the source it was built from -- the `fuelrun.v2.*` case that burned both lanes
controls.can_fail_because: the device binary predates its source, or the two binaries hash identically (which would mean one ISA never ran)
controls.null_must_contain: a device binary older than soakrun.rs, which is the stale-artifact case

falsifiers.name: F_reuse_not_safe_on_device
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the device shows more than one distinct canon digest across positions, OR the device probe canon digest differs from the host's
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a device whose canon digests drift with position, or differ from the host's
falsifiers.refutes: M1.3b's conclusion transferring to the deployment target: if it fires, process reuse is not safe on the phone and WorkManager goes back to blocked
falsifiers.fires_when: the device shows more than one distinct canon digest across positions, OR the device probe canon digest differs from the host's
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F_committed_rows_reproduce
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any row of the committed TSV differs from the same position measured today
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a build whose per-row digests are unchanged since 08:47, which is what "the corpus is deterministic" is usually taken to mean
falsifiers.refutes: M1.3b's committed soak.tsv as a REPRODUCIBLE artifact: if its rows do not reproduce, the digests in it are a record of one build, not of the corpus
falsifiers.fires_when: any row of the committed TSV differs from the same position measured today

falsifier: device canon digests drifting with position, or differing from the host's, which would mean process reuse is unsafe on the deployment target
